configuredOccurrences.cost: $10 per child.

configuredOccurrences.title: Yoga for Littles
configuredOccurrences.summary: Ages 3–6 with an adult. Enjoy our nature-inspired yoga class for little ones! configuredOccurrences.summary: Ages 2–5 with an adult. Bring your little ones to our not-so-spooky annual trail adventure!
